cues.en: Hello my friends.
cues.zh: 朋友們好。

cues.en: Welcome back to Amazon SageMaker Canvas, and welcome to this, your hands-on tutorial where this time we will build a classification model.
cues.zh: 歡迎回到 Amazon SageMaker Canvas，這堂實作要建立分類模型。

cues.en: Therefore, let's go back to our models.
cues.zh: 回到 My models。

cues.en: Here is our regression model we just built in the previous tutorial, where the problem type was indeed numeric prediction, but now we're gonna tackle a new problem type,
cues.zh: 這是上一堂的迴歸模型，問題類型是數值預測，現在處理新類型，

cues.en: and we're gonna create a new model for, of course, classification.
cues.zh: 建立分類模型。

cues.en: Classification Model. All right.
cues.zh: Classification model，好。

cues.en: It's still predictive analysis, of course, but you will see that it's gonna be for binary classification.
cues.zh: 當然仍是 Predictive analysis，但會做二元分類。

cues.en: Because this time we're gonna predict if a patient has a benign or malignant cancer tumor.
cues.zh: 因為要預測病患的乳房腫瘤是良性或惡性。

cues.en: So we could predictive analysis here. Then we click Create.
cues.zh: 保留 Predictive analysis，按 Create。

cues.en: Then dataset selection.
cues.zh: 選資料集。

cues.en: Of course, this time we're gonna select the Classification Dataset, which we imported in the SageMaker setup tutorial.
cues.zh: 這次當然選設定教學匯入的 Classification dataset。

cues.en: So, Classification Dataset, Select dataset.
cues.zh: 選它，按 Select dataset。

cues.en: It's gonna take us, there we go, to the Build step of this whole model building process.
cues.zh: 來到整個建模流程的 Build。

cues.en: And again, the first step we have to do here is to select the Target column.
cues.zh: 第一步同樣選目標欄。

cues.en: And of course that's the last column here, Class, which I remind can take only two values, therefore it's binary classification, either 2, which means that the patient
cues.zh: 最後一欄 Class，記得只取兩個值，因此二元分類；2 表示

cues.en: has a benign breast cancer tumor, or 4, meaning that unfortunately the patient has malignant breast cancer tumor.
cues.zh: 良性乳房腫瘤，4 則很不幸，表示惡性乳房腫瘤。

cues.en: Okay, so Class is selected, and automatically all the other variables are identified as features, which are the independent variables with which you are gonna predict the dependent variable,
cues.zh: 選好 Class，其他變數自動辨識為特徵、自變數，用來預測依變數，

cues.en: or so-called target, which is the class.
cues.zh: 也就是目標 Class。

cues.en: Okay, great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now, next step, let's configure our model.
cues.zh: 下一步設定模型。

cues.en: And so there we go. Model type.
cues.zh: 模型類型。

cues.en: This time the model type or problem type is a two-category problem slash model.
cues.zh: 這次問題／模型類型是 Two category。

cues.en: Indeed, the two categories are either 2, benign tumor, or 4, malignant tumor.
cues.zh: 兩類分別 2 良性、4 惡性。

cues.en: So here of course, we keep that option.
cues.zh: 當然保留。

cues.en: Great. And now let's go through the advanced configuration.
cues.zh: 看看進階設定。

cues.en: And once again I remind that this can come up at the exam.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，可能考試出現。

cues.en: So please focus to understand the different parts of the configuration here, starting with the Objective metric, where this time we'll have completely different objective
cues.zh: 請專心理解各部分，先從 Objective metric，這次有完全不同的

cues.en: performance metrics.
cues.zh: 效能目標指標。

cues.en: We have first the F1 score, which is a measure of a model's accuracy in binary classification tasks.
cues.zh: 首先 F1 score，用來衡量二元分類模型表現。

cues.en: So it's well fitted to our problem actually, and it averages two important metrics, precision and recall.
cues.zh: 適合這問題，平均兩個重要指標：精確率與召回率。

cues.en: F1 works well for imbalanced datasets. Okay?
cues.zh: F1 對不平衡資料集很有用。

cues.en: So try to remember this in case it comes up at the exam.
cues.zh: 記住，考試可能會問。

cues.en: And now let's have a look at the other objective metrics for classification.
cues.zh: 看看其他分類指標。

cues.en: We of course have the accuracy, which is the most intuitive to understand.
cues.zh: 當然有 Accuracy，最直覺。

cues.en: It's basically the number of correct predictions divided by the total number of observations in your dataset, whether it is the training set or the test set.
cues.zh: 正確預測數量，除以全部觀測筆數，不論訓練集或測試集。

cues.en: And so indeed, the accuracy score tells you how often the model's predictions are correct overall.
cues.zh: 表示整體預測多常正確。

cues.en: A higher accuracy score indicates that the model is making more correct predictions, while a lower one suggests that the model is making more errors, and it works well for balanced datasets insight.
cues.zh: 高表示正確多，低表示錯誤多，適合平衡資料集。

cues.en: So remember this: F1 score is better for imbalanced datasets, while accuracy works better for balanced datasets.
cues.zh: 記住，F1 對不平衡較好，Accuracy 對平衡較好。

cues.en: Now let's have a look at the other ones.
cues.zh: 看看其他。

cues.en: We have the area under curve, or ROC curve, which represents the degree of separability, or in other words, the model's capability of distinguishing between classes.
cues.zh: AUC，ROC 曲線下面積，代表可分程度，也就是區分類別的能力。

cues.en: Basically the higher the AUC score, the better the model's performance in terms of correctly ranking positive instances higher than negative instances.
cues.zh: AUC 越高，表示越能把正例排序在負例前面。

cues.en: Okay, now finally the last two ones, Precision, and Recall, very important for the exam as well.
cues.zh: 最後兩個 Precision、Recall，考試也重要。

cues.en: Basically the precision score tells you how reliable the model's positive predictions are, and it focuses on the accuracy of positive predictions relative to all the instances the model predicted
cues.zh: 精確率表示陽性預測多可靠，聚焦預測為陽性的全部案例中，

cues.en: as positive.
cues.zh: 真正陽性的比例。

cues.en: And make sure to know the formula of the precision score, as you saw in the theory lectures.
cues.zh: 務必知道理論教學的精確率公式。

cues.en: And finally the last objective metric here, Recall, which tells you how well the model predicts positive instances, and it focuses on the ability of the model to correctly identify all positive instances.
cues.zh: 最後召回率，表示識別正例的能力，關心能否找出全部真正陽性。

cues.en: A recall score of 1 indicates that the model can perfectly identify all positive instances.
cues.zh: 召回率 1，代表全部正例都找到了。

cues.en: Okay, now training method and algorithm.
cues.zh: 現在 Training method and algorithms。

cues.en: So same, we have the Auto option, which is the one we'll use to quickly build our model.
cues.zh: 同樣有 Auto，會用它快速建立。

cues.en: But let's have a look at the Ensemble option so that we can see what are the algorithms you can use to build a classification model.
cues.zh: 但看看 Ensemble，知道分類可用哪些演算法。

cues.en: And actually that's the same as in regression.
cues.zh: 其實和迴歸相同。

cues.en: You have XGBoost, Linear Models, LightGBM, CatBoost, Random Forest, Extra Trees, Neural Networks Built Using PyTorch, and Neural Networks Built Using Fast.ai.
cues.zh: XGBoost、Linear models、LightGBM、CatBoost、Random forest、Extra trees、PyTorch 神經網路、Fast.ai 神經網路。

cues.en: So that's the same.
cues.zh: 一樣。

cues.en: And once again, you can select some of them.
cues.zh: 可以只選部分。

cues.en: You don't have to use all of them in the final model.
cues.zh: 不必全放進最終模型。

cues.en: But of course if you select a models, we have what we call an Ensemble model where all these models here will be trained to make predictions, and then through a voting system,
cues.zh: 全部選的話，這些模型都訓練並預測，形成集成，再透過投票，

cues.en: the Ensemble model is trained to make the most accurate prediction.
cues.zh: 讓集成模型做最準確預測。

cues.en: And then same, Data split, we'll have 80% of data points going to the Training set and 20% in the Validation set, and Max candidates and runtime, not relevant here.
cues.zh: Data split 同樣 80% 訓練、20% 驗證；Max candidates and runtime 這裡無關。

cues.en: It's only for standard build.
cues.zh: 只對 Standard build 有用。

cues.en: We will use quick build, and this won't be part of the exam.
cues.zh: 我們用 Quick build，這項不會考。

cues.en: Okay, so there we go.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Let's check that we have, well, the Auto option selected, right?
cues.zh: 檢查已選 Auto。

cues.en: Just to save cost and time.
cues.zh: 節省成本、時間。

cues.en: Objective metric, well, Recall is actually the best one for cancer prediction, because it measures how many actual cancer cases your model correctly identifies.
cues.zh: 目標指標方面，講者認為癌症預測最適合 Recall，因為衡量真正癌症找出多少。

cues.en: And in medicine, indeed, missing a cancer case, meaning a false negative, can be very dangerous.
cues.zh: 醫療上漏掉癌症，也就是偽陰性，非常危險。

cues.en: And then other good ones are of course the F1 score, or the accuracy.
cues.zh: 其他不錯選擇當然是 F1 或準確率。

cues.en: Maybe let's choose Accuracy, because it's the most intuitive to understand.
cues.zh: 這裡選 Accuracy，因為最直覺。

cues.en: We'll have a pretty good idea of how well our model is performing on our patient's data.
cues.zh: 能了解模型在病患資料上的表現。

cues.en: And of course, the higher the accuracy, the better.
cues.zh: 當然越高越好。

cues.en: Okay, perfect. So now let's click Save.
cues.zh: 很好，按 Save。

cues.en: The model is ready to be trained.
cues.zh: 模型可開始訓練。

cues.en: And so once again, let's click Quick build.
cues.zh: 再次按 Quick build。

cues.en: Validating your data, and very soon it's gonna start training the model.
cues.zh: 正在驗證資料，很快開始訓練。

cues.en: First, it is preprocessing the dataset.
cues.zh: 先做前處理。

cues.en: It can take a few minutes, yes, but it's gonna take I would say even less time than last time because the dataset is even smaller.
cues.zh: 可能幾分鐘，但應比上次更快，因為資料更小。

cues.en: And in a second we'll have the training page, you know, with the model getting trained on the dataset.
cues.zh: 稍後看到訓練頁，模型在資料集上訓練。

cues.en: Okay, there we go. 2:15 minutes.
cues.zh: 好了，2 到 15 分鐘。

cues.en: Same quick build, but I think it's gonna be even faster.
cues.zh: 同樣 Quick build，但應該更快。

cues.en: Generating column impact.
cues.zh: 正在產生欄位影響程度。

cues.en: And you will have other steps of the training here.
cues.zh: 也會看到其他步驟。

cues.en: And there we go, I'll see you at the end of the training.
cues.zh: 訓練完成再見。

cues.en: All right, the training is about to be finished.
cues.zh: 訓練快好了。

cues.en: Once again it took two or three minutes, maybe a bit less than the regression problem.
cues.zh: 又是兩三分鐘，可能比迴歸稍短。

cues.en: And there we go, that's another survey.
cues.zh: 這又是問卷。

cues.en: And we end up with a beautiful accuracy of 93.431%.
cues.zh: 最後準確率 93.431%，很漂亮。

cues.en: That's really good.
cues.zh: 相當好。

cues.en: It means that our model will be correct at predicting the breast cancer tumor as benign or malignant 93% of the time.
cues.zh: 代表預測乳房腫瘤良性或惡性，大約 93% 正確。

cues.en: And once again, we have the feature's impact on the target, which is class.
cues.zh: 同樣有特徵對 Class 的影響。

cues.en: Bare Nuclei comes first with a 30% impact.
cues.zh: Bare Nuclei 裸核第一，30%。

cues.en: Then comes Uniformity of Cell Size, with 27.5% impact, Uniformity of Cell Shape, 15% impact, et cetera.
cues.zh: Uniformity of Cell Size 細胞大小均勻度 27.5%，細胞形狀均勻度 15%，等等。

cues.en: Okay, here on the right you have the impact of Bare Nuclei on prediction of class, between either 2 or 4.
cues.zh: 右邊是裸核對預測 2 或 4 的影響。

cues.en: And again, you have some more information related to the scoring.
cues.zh: Scoring 還有更多資訊。

cues.en: So here you have some model accuracy insights, which says indeed that, "If the model predicts 2, "it is correct 95.5% of the time," and "for the values that are 2 in the dataset,
cues.zh: 模型準確率洞見寫著：「如果預測 2，95.5% 是對的」；「資料集真正為 2 的值，

cues.en: "the model predicted 94.382% of them to be 2."

And if you want the same insights for the class 4, well you just click here, and you will have that, "If the model predicts 4, "it's correct 89.796% of the time," which now we understand why the accuracy
cues.zh: 要看第 4 類，就點這裡，「如果預測 4，89.796% 是對的」，現在就理解整體準確率

cues.en: is between the two, right?
cues.zh: 為什麼落在兩者之間。

cues.en: Because for the class 2 it was about 95%.
cues.zh: 第 2 類大約 95%。

cues.en: And "for the values that are 4 in the dataset, "the model predicted 91.667% of them to be 4."
cues.zh: 「資料集真正為 4 的值，91.667% 被預測為 4」。

cues.en: Okay? So you have some good model accuracy insights.
cues.zh: 有很好的準確率洞見。

cues.en: And then, finally, you have also the Advanced metrics.
cues.zh: 最後還有 Advanced metrics。

cues.en: All the other metrics that we saw before in the configuration, precision of 0.898, recall of 0.917, accuracy of 0.934,
cues.zh: 剛才設定裡的其他指標，Precision 0.898、Recall 0.917、Accuracy 0.934，

cues.en: F1 score of 0.907.
That's an excellent F1 score as well.
cues.zh: 也是很好的 F1。

cues.en: And the AUC of 0.973. Really good.
cues.zh: AUC 0.973，非常好。

cues.en: And the Confusion matrix, of course, with the true positive, true negative, false positive, and false negative, you can actually practice to compute precision and recall with those numbers here.
cues.zh: 當然也有混淆矩陣，真陽性、真陰性、偽陽性、偽陰性，可以用這些數字練習算精確率與召回率。

cues.en: Right? It can be really good for the exam.
cues.zh: 對考試很有幫助。

cues.en: And finally, you have the Precision recall curve giving you the graph of Precision with respect to Recall.
cues.zh: 最後 Precision-recall curve，呈現精確率相對召回率。

cues.en: Okay, great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now, finally, let's move on to the last step, the Predict step, because then the deployment will be covered in a further section of the course.
cues.zh: 最後進 Predict，部署後面章節會介紹。

cues.en: And so once again, you can either do batch predictions or a single prediction.
cues.zh: 同樣可以批次或單筆預測。

cues.en: We're gonna do a single prediction.
cues.zh: 我們做單筆。

cues.en: And just like with regression, you enter your feature values here.
cues.zh: 和迴歸一樣，在這裡填特徵值。

cues.en: So let's put some random values here.
cues.zh: 隨意輸入一些。

cues.en: It doesn't matter. Okay?
cues.zh: 這裡只是示範。

cues.en: Clump Thickness, I'm gonna put 3.
cues.zh: Clump Thickness 填 3。

cues.en: I'm really not a doctor or from a medical background, so I have no idea what I'm putting, but I hope that makes sense, at least a bit of sense.
cues.zh: 我不是醫師，也沒醫療背景，不知道這些數值是否合理，希望多少合理。

cues.en: Marginal Adhesion, 5.
cues.zh: Marginal Adhesion 填 5。

cues.en: Single Epithelial Cell Size, 3, Bare Nuclei, 2.
cues.zh: Single Epithelial Cell Size 填 3，Bare Nuclei 填 2。

cues.en: Blunt Chromatin, 4.
cues.zh: Bland Chromatin 填 4。

cues.en: Normal Nucleoli, 3.
cues.zh: Normal Nucleoli 填 3。

cues.en: Mitosis, at least I remember more or less what it is.
cues.zh: Mitosis 至少大致記得是什麼。

cues.en: I'm gonna put 2. Okay?
cues.zh: 填 2，好嗎？

cues.en: My apologies of course to any doctor here if this doesn't make any sense.
cues.zh: 如果數值不合理，向在座醫師致歉。

cues.en: And now to get the final prediction, we click here, Update prediction, and it will give us the prediction of the breast cancer tumor, whether it is benign or malignant for a hypothetical patient
cues.zh: 按 Update prediction，取得假想病患在這些乳房特徵值下，

cues.en: with these feature values of the breast.
cues.zh: 腫瘤良性或惡性的預測。

cues.en: Okay? And the class prediction is 2.
cues.zh: Class 預測為 2。

cues.en: Meaning that fortunately, our patient is predicted to have a benign breast cancer tumor.
cues.zh: 幸好，預測為良性腫瘤。

cues.en: All right, so that's it for classification.
cues.zh: 好，分類介紹到此。

cues.en: I'll look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂實作見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
